source.title: Linguistic Survey of India - Jharkhand
source.producer: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (ORGI)

verified_observations: The first-party ORGI indexed PDF endpoint is discoverable and search-indexed as LSI_JHARKHAND.pdf.
The indexed first-party PDF text contains the heading: 'Distribution of Mundari Language in Jharkhand state as per 2011 Census is presented in the following tables.'
The indexed table exposes State/Districts with Total, Rural and Urban columns, each split into Person, Males and Females.
The indexed Jharkhand total row reports 942108 persons, 470532 males and 471576 females; rural 867023 persons, 433527 males and 433496 females; urban 75085 persons, 37005 males and 38080 females.

evidence_boundary.promote_as: first-party indexed-PDF exact table locator and source-level quantitative evidence candidate
evidence_boundary.reason_numeric_not_promoted: The PDF binary endpoint returned a transient fetch failure during this run, so page-image screenshot verification, independent byte hash, local page inventory and printed-page/PDF-page concordance were not completed.
evidence_boundary.rights_note: Government publication and discoverability establish source identity/access, not blanket downstream reuse permission or community/cultural authorization.

retry_state.next_action: Retry permitted PDF byte acquisition; then hash, inventory pages, screenshot the Mundari distribution table page, and promote only cells whose page/cell provenance is independently verified.
